probes.label: ExitStack 逆序退出
probes.code:
from contextlib import ExitStack
class CM:
    def __init__(self, n): self.n = n
    def __enter__(self): print('enter', self.n); return self
    def __exit__(self, *a): print('exit', self.n); return False
with ExitStack() as st:
    st.enter_context(CM(1))
    st.enter_context(CM(2))
print('done')
